name: Zhang Ruoxu
source:
A cool and gentle man with a talent of literature.
As a taoist, he wears a round collar shirt and looks as if a god comes to the earth.
"It's a hard chance to meet you, and I'm proud to see you."
"I'll appreciate your kindness since I received it from you."
(Translated from Weibo)
